answer: A durable defense is stake-weighted reputation tied to verifiable work. Each agent must complete costly, checkable tasks and lock a deposit before its votes count; a cloned identity restarts from zero, so copies are not free. Like water shaping karst, trust builds slowly through honest work and collapses quickly after fraud, so a ripple of bad attestations can be traced and slashed. A signed quill of evidence—an auditable log of tasks, deposits, and peer checks—lets honest nodes reject cheap copies without a central gatekeeper, making a Sybil swarm expensive to build and easy to expose.
